0.long_answer: The tetracycline antibiotic referred to is minocycline. Minocycline is unique among the tetracycline class due to its availability as both an oral formulation and as a topical foam, which is specifically FDA-approved for the treatment of inflammatory rosacea (under the brand name Zilxi). In addition to its use in managing rosacea, minocycline is also prescribed for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, where its anti-inflammatory properties contribute to its therapeutic effects.
